author: v. j. morris
title: Miami Dolphins sign punter Bradley Pinion as unrestricted free agent
text:
The Miami Dolphins announced on March 20 that they have signed punter Bradley Pinion as an unrestricted free agent.
Pinion brings extensive experience to the team, having played in 179 career games over 11 seasons with San Francisco, Tampa Bay, and Atlanta. His addition is expected to strengthen the Dolphins’ special teams unit.
Throughout his career, Pinion has recorded 751 punts for a total of 33,393 yards, averaging 44.5 yards per punt and a net average of 40.0 yards. He has pinned opponents inside the 20-yard line on 271 occasions and handled 804 kickoffs. Pinion has also appeared in six postseason games and was part of the Tampa Bay team that won Super Bowl LV.
Pinion entered the National Football League as a fifth-round pick (165th overall) by San Francisco in the 2015 NFL Draft. Before his professional career, he played at Clemson University from 2012 to 2014, appearing in 34 games and recording 140 punts for a total of 5,754 yards with an average of 41.1 yards per punt.
The signing adds depth and experience to the Dolphins’ roster as they prepare for the upcoming season.
